desc: Implement formula skeleton: read input, prefix sums PA, PB, compute base = Y·PA(X) + X·PB(Y) per query.
Implement CDQ solver computing M1-style contributions (CDQ on position axis; inner sweep by value with Fenwick on the other axis); verify on sample by hand.
Run solver twice (A-vs-B for M1 with ≤, B-vs-A for M2 with <) and combine: ans = base − 2·(M1+M2).
Test on both samples; add brute-force checker (random small N,K) to validate.
Benchmark on max-size random input (N=1e5, K=1e4): ~14.5 s CPython; identified bottleneck as N·log²N Fenwick updates from global-V sweep; carried-sublists variant gets ~11.9 s.

Optimize the CDQ solver for speed: single-pass CDQ computing M1 and M2 simultaneously, BIT micro-optimizations; re-verify correctness (samples + brute-force checker) and re-benchmark. (Done: caught and fixed M2 weight bug — w2 = totA − psumA[pa1], single pointer; ~6.3 s CPython, samples + 400 stress cases pass.)
Final verification pass: re-run both samples + random brute-force stress on the final single-pass code to confirm the corrected M2 weight; confirm code cleanliness for submission.
